title: Unique Golden Italian Milk Stracciatella
description: A festive Italian dessert featuring golden syrup and a lamination-puff pastry, this stracciatella is a unique twist on a classic Calabrian dish, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk, golden syrup, and vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, turbinado sugar, and salt.
Add the egg mixture to the milk mixture and whisk until well combined.
Pour the mixture onto the rolled out puff pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to form a crust.
Brush the melted butter over the crust.
Place the stracciatella on a lazy-susan-spinner and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
